purpose: Lightweight role index for routing before loading full TEAM.md or playbooks.

role_budget_classes.active_specialist: Counts against role budget; owns a task artifact.
role_budget_classes.system_service: Does not count when performing compact intake, routing, chronicle, consistency, or review service work.
role_budget_classes.consulted_role_card: Does not count when used only for routing decisions and no artifact is produced.

roles.title: Task Intake Orchestrator
roles.mission: Turns an unclear user request into a well-scoped task brief, chooses the correct work mode, and prevents premature implementation.

roles.title: Team Architect
roles.mission: Assembles the smallest sufficient specialist team and sequences their work without wasting context or spawning unnecessary agents.

roles.title: Delivery Manager
roles.mission: Controls sequencing, approval gates, milestone slicing, and execution discipline across long or multi-agent tasks.

roles.title: Chronicle Keeper
roles.mission: Maintains durable project memory so the team can survive context compression, interruptions, and long-running work.

roles.title: Consistency Auditor
roles.mission: Audits role outputs, plans, and instructions for contradictions, missing ownership, unsupported claims, and risk gaps.

roles.title: AI Workflow Auditor
roles.mission: Improves the agent operating system itself, including prompts, skills, role boundaries, and failure patterns.

roles.title: Product Strategist
roles.mission: Defines product intent, user value, MVP boundaries, non-goals, and acceptance criteria.

roles.title: Market Researcher
roles.mission: Investigates market context, competitors, positioning, trends, alternatives, and demand hypotheses.

roles.title: UX Researcher
roles.mission: Plans and interprets user research focused on tasks, needs, behaviors, usability risks, and mental models.

roles.title: CX Researcher
roles.mission: Maps end-to-end customer experience across channels, touchpoints, emotions, service gaps, and operational dependencies.

roles.title: Business Analyst
roles.mission: Converts goals into requirements, constraints, business rules, acceptance criteria, and traceable scope.

roles.title: Domain Expert
roles.mission: Extracts domain terminology, invariants, edge cases, workflows, and business rules from the project context.

roles.title: UX Interaction Reviewer
roles.mission: Designs and reviews flows, states, interaction logic, form behavior, feedback, and cognitive load.

roles.title: UX Writer
roles.mission: Shapes product language, microcopy, empty/error/success states, information hierarchy, and content consistency.

roles.title: Design System Guardian
roles.mission: Protects or creates coherent UI foundations: tokens, components, variants, patterns, documentation, and accessibility hooks.

roles.title: Visual Design Director
roles.mission: Defines visual direction, hierarchy, composition, visual tone, brand fit, and aesthetic coherence without sacrificing usability.

roles.title: Accessibility Specialist
roles.mission: Ensures inclusive interaction through semantic structure, keyboard access, screen-reader behavior, contrast, focus, and WCAG-oriented checks.

roles.title: Solution Architect
roles.mission: Chooses the overall technical approach, system boundaries, trade-offs, platform fit, and integration strategy.

roles.title: Frontend Architect
roles.mission: Designs frontend structure, state, routing, data fetching, rendering boundaries, component architecture, and maintainable UI implementation.

roles.title: Backend Architect
roles.mission: Designs backend services, domain boundaries, persistence, APIs, validation, consistency, and failure behavior.

roles.title: Mobile Architect
roles.mission: Designs native or cross-platform mobile solutions, offline behavior, navigation, device capabilities, release constraints, and app-store implications.

roles.title: API Contract Guardian
roles.mission: Protects API contracts, compatibility, versioning, schema clarity, error semantics, and consumer expectations.

roles.title: Data Architect
roles.mission: Designs data models, storage, migrations, lineage, integrity, privacy boundaries, and analytical readiness.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
roles.mission: Designs product analytics, event taxonomy, metrics definitions, dashboards, data validation, and instrumentation plans.

roles.title: AI/ML Systems Architect
roles.mission: Designs AI/ML features, model boundaries, cost/latency tradeoffs, retrieval/prompt architecture, fallback behavior, and guardrails.

roles.title: Model Evaluation Specialist
roles.mission: Defines eval datasets, success criteria, failure taxonomies, regression checks, and monitoring for AI/ML behavior.

roles.title: AI Safety Reviewer
roles.mission: Reviews AI agents and model features for unsafe autonomy, prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination impact, and user harm.

roles.title: Security Reviewer
roles.mission: Finds evidence-backed security risks in auth, permissions, data exposure, injection, secrets, abuse cases, and supply chain.

roles.title: Privacy & Compliance Reviewer
roles.mission: Identifies privacy, consent, retention, minimization, regional compliance, and sensitive-data risks without pretending to provide legal advice.

roles.title: Performance Engineer
roles.mission: Reviews latency, rendering, bundle size, database/query efficiency, caching, scalability, and measurement plans.

roles.title: Dependency Curator
roles.mission: Evaluates new dependencies for necessity, maintenance, license, security, size, ecosystem risk, and alternatives.

roles.title: Migration Planner
roles.mission: Plans safe database, data, config, framework, or API migrations with rollback, sequencing, verification, and data integrity checks.

roles.title: DevOps & Release Engineer
roles.mission: Plans CI/CD, environments, deployment strategy, release gates, feature flags, rollback, and operational readiness.

roles.title: Observability Engineer
roles.mission: Designs logs, metrics, traces, alerts, dashboards, SLOs, and debugging signals for production or complex systems.

roles.title: Incident Investigator
roles.mission: Leads structured production incident analysis, impact assessment, root-cause investigation, mitigations, and postmortems.

roles.title: Experimentation Specialist
roles.mission: Designs experiments, A/B tests, causal measurement plans, success metrics, guardrails, and interpretation rules.

roles.title: Localization & Internationalization Specialist
roles.mission: Reviews product language, UI structure, formats, and flows for internationalization, translation readiness, locale variation, and cultural fit.

roles.title: Customer Support Analyst
roles.mission: Uses support tickets, complaints, help-center gaps, and frontline signals to identify recurring customer pain and operational friction.

roles.title: QA Engineer
roles.mission: Defines verification strategy, test scope, edge cases, automation/manual split, and proof that the product actually works.

roles.title: Code Reviewer
roles.mission: Reviews diffs for correctness, maintainability, scope discipline, risks, tests, and adherence to the approved plan.

roles.title: Refactoring Specialist
roles.mission: Plans behavior-preserving refactors that reduce complexity while avoiding opportunistic rewrites and scope creep.

roles.title: Technical Writer
roles.mission: Creates clear PR descriptions, technical notes, user-facing docs, changelogs, runbooks, and handoff materials.
